owner_creation.analysis: cmdbuf owns 2048 static bytes including a C-string terminator; cp and cmd_offset borrow/index that same fixed array.
owner_creation.invariant: The command array owns bytes independently of cursor aliases.
limitations: cmdbuf is image-owned static array storage; completion and history allocate separate heap objects.

aliases_escapes.analysis: get_cmdbuf returns a borrowed raw C-string address and edit helpers retain interior pointers; the ABI expresses no lifetime preventing a later edit while a reader uses cmdbuf.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Escaped command-string borrows must not span mutation.
limitations: The fixed array address survives edits, but reset or insertion invalidates saved text interpretation and cursor assumptions.

callback_targets.analysis: Editing cmdbuf calls width, repaint and output functions while terminal output shares mutable display state with the editing operation.
callback_targets.invariant: Direct editing calls do not protect shared display aliases.
limitations: Direct history and editing calls do not lend an exclusive owner token.

invalidation.analysis: Reset, insertion, erasure and history/completion edits rewrite the cmdbuf array in place; stable address does not preserve old text seen by a retained pointer.
invalidation.invariant: In-place edits invalidate the contents of prior borrows.

mutation_commit.analysis: cmd_ichar checks cmdbuf length, shifts suffix/terminator and copies input bytes before repaint; those raw steps are not a staged owner replacement.
mutation_commit.invariant: Capacity checks and logical edit publication remain separate.

release_pair.analysis: The cmdbuf array must never be freed; owned history/completion copies are separate heap objects whose destruction cannot release this static storage.
release_pair.invariant: Command-array addresses are not heap allocations.
limitations: Neither cmdbuf nor any interior cp address may be freed; only separate history/completion allocations take heap release.

error_cleanup.analysis: A full cmdbuf rejects insertion with action 2 before shifting; retained raw string aliases and rendering failure remain separate contracts.
error_cleanup.invariant: Rejected capacity must not publish partial new text.

signals_handoff.analysis: The cmdbuf private array is reached through exported editing functions and raw globals without an exclusive Rust owner or handler exclusion protocol.
signals_handoff.invariant: Static backing lifetime does not establish safe mutation access.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

src/signal.rs.relationship: terminate at src/signal.rs:83-85 enters quit without naming cmdbuf. The raw editor owner lacks an encoded exclusion contract, but this citation alone does not establish a cleanup-to-cmdbuf mutation route.
